standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the romedb-production profile; 344 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Passed from the 0.2.13 to 0.2.28 packages on Node 22.0.0 and 24.19.0 (groups v0213-upgrade-restore to v0228-upgrade-restore). 0.2.13 is the floor: it changed the stored value prefix, and earlier files are refused. 0.2.29 adds no storage format change, and 0.2.28 can open its files.

engine.exceptions: the maintained engine exceptions retained; one test-only backport added (romedb/docs/core-exceptions.md)
engine.storageFormat: __romedb_ schema prefix, .romedb extension, stored values prefixed RDB 01 (FDB 01 before 0.2.13); openEmbedded and serve use MVCC files; collections with a * array path index use catalog version 8, others keep version 7 or earlier; collections with a weighted full-text index use catalog version 9; collections with a folded or stemmed full-text index use catalog version 10; collections with a full-text index that declares filter paths use catalog version 11
engine.change: Turso v0.8.4 (72eafab83) from romedb/romedb#103, replacing v0.8.3; Tantivy 0.27.0 unchanged. Upstream fixes: a DELETE with an ON DELETE foreign key action collects its row IDs first; an UPDATE that changes row IDs opens a statement savepoint; re-preparing a stale statement no longer ends another statement's autocommit transaction; UPSERT reads the CDC before image first. All RomeDB engine exceptions are kept; a test-only backport of upstream c7588f403 is added. url 2.5.9 for RUSTSEC-2026-0592; aws-lc-rs 1.18.2. No storage format change
